subject: Exponential survival: low estimates and narrow intervals

messages.author: 78f18e5a32647f45
messages.subject: Exponential survival: low estimates and narrow intervals
parts:
Dear INLA community

I found weird results when I fit an exponential survival model. I simulated some data for survival analysis and fitted a model with two fixed effects using three different families: coxph, exponential.surv, and weibull.surv. Models with coxph and weibull gave similar fixed effect estimates while the exponential model gave some estimates that are really close to the intercept value with narrow intervals. I tried different seeds but I always found these narrow results by the exponential model. Is there any explanation for these results? Attached is the code I used to generate the results.

Thank you.

Kind regards,
Yessika
